text_blocks.snippet: Harry Connick Jr.'s wife, Jill Goodacre, has battled breast cancer. She was diagnosed with Stage 1 invasive ductal carcinoma in 2012 after a routine mammogram and sonogram. She underwent a lumpectomy and radiation, and was prescribed Tamoxifen. She has been in remission since 2017.
Details of Jill Goodacre's Breast Cancer Battle:

list.title: Diagnosis:
list.snippet: Jill Goodacre's breast cancer journey began with a routine mammogram in October 2012, which was followed by a sonogram that revealed a tumor.

list.title: Treatment:
list.snippet: She had a lumpectomy, radiation treatment, and was prescribed Tamoxifen, an estrogen modulator, to help prevent further cancer development.

list.title: Emotional Impact:
list.snippet: Harry Connick Jr. shared that he was scared of losing his wife, as he had lost his mother to ovarian cancer at a young age.

list.title: Public Revelation:
list.snippet: The couple kept Jill's cancer battle private for five years before publicly sharing their experience in 2017.

list.title: Remission and Ongoing Concerns:
list.snippet: While Jill Goodacre has been in remission since 2017, she admits to still feeling nervous about the possibility of recurrence, as she is required to get regular checkups, according to People.com.

list.title: Impact on Others:
list.snippet: The couple shared their story to raise awareness about the importance of early cancer screenings and have even heard from people who said their story led them to get screened and detect their own cancers early.
